name: research-brief
description: Short research brief with N sources, a comparison table and citations
goal: Write a research brief on: {topic}. Use exactly {n} distinct, reputable sources.
constraints: Use live web search (enabled for this job) and prefer primary/official sources, most recent first. Cite every factual claim inline as [n] with a numbered source list (title, URL, publication date if shown, date accessed). No paywalled or invented sources; write 'unknown' where a fact could not be verified. Output brief.md only.
done_when: brief.md exists with a 3-5 sentence summary, a markdown comparison table, {n} numbered sources with URLs, and inline [n] citations.
